(May 2019)": 816 top-level comments (1402131 bytes, the largest thread seen), 4 kept: location-first ("London, UK | TESSIAN"), remote-negated ("Onsite Only", "ONSITE only") and a header where "Remote OK" is followed by "No Visa". UNCLEAR: the Y Combinator terms (https://www.ycombinator.com/legal/, "Site") say "you will not engage in or use any data mining, robots, scraping or similar data gathering or extraction methods", while the HN Search API on Algolia (https://hn.algolia.com/api) is a public, unauthenticated, documented endpoint. No capture of the terms page is committed; the quote was read at that URL on 2026-10-24 by an AI coding agent (not legal advice; no review by a lawyer or the owner is recorded here) and is unverifiable from this repository. Whether that API counts as "the Site" is a question for the owner, which was put to him and is unanswered, so the source stays blocked. robots.txt of news.ycombinator.com sets Crawl-delay: 30 and does not disallow /item; hn.algolia.com serves no robots.txt (404). UNVERIFIABLE FROM THIS REPOSITORY: that none of the 1331 top-level comments in the three threads read (816 + 266 + 249) was deleted; those captures were removed because they held commenters' e-mail addresses. Employers are NOT given by the API: a comment is free text whose first paragraph is a header, so every observation is tagged employer-unverified. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short text to limit exposure). LATER HAND REDACTION (not produced by the script; rawSha256 is unchanged): the slug of a poster's personal LinkedIn profile link (written with / slashes, in the href and in the link text) was replaced by a same-length run of x characters; fileSha256 above is the hash after that edit. LATER HAND SUBSTITUTION (not produced by the script; rawSha256 is unchanged): the HN account names (author fields) of 3 people were replaced by synthetic one-to-one names hnuser01..hnuser24; fileSha256 above is the hash after that edit. The posting bot whoishiring and the company account Tessian are kept.
